# Sanako

> Sanako provides comprehensive language teaching software and hardware solutions for schools, universities, and language educators worldwide.

Sanako specializes in digital language lab technology, classroom management platforms, and interactive learning tools designed for ESL, EFL, and MFL instruction. The company serves over 50,000 users globally with both web-based and physical lab solutions.

## Key Topics

- Language teaching software
- Digital language lab
- Sanako Connect
- Sanako Study
- Sanako Lab 100
- Classroom management
- Speaking practice
- Pronunciation grading
- Interactive audio/video tasks
- Web-based platform
- ESL/EFL education
- Live and asynchronous teaching
- Student assessment
- Speech recognition
- Language learning

## Core Products

- [Sanako Connect](https://sanako.com/connect): Web-based platform for classroom and remote language teaching with live and asynchronous modes
- [Sanako Study](https://sanako.com/study): Language lab software for classroom management and interactive language learning activities
- [Sanako Lab 100](https://sanako.com/lab-100): Physical digital language lab hardware for offline teaching environments
- [School Headsets (SLH-07)](https://sanako.com/headsets): Durable headphones designed specifically for language learning in school settings

## Teaching Features & Tools

- [Automated Pronunciation Grading](https://sanako.com/automated-pronunciation-grading): Speech recognition technology for automated pronunciation assessment and feedback
- [Interactive Audio and Video Tasks](https://sanako.com/interactive-audio-video-tasks): Create interactive audio and video tasks for engaging speaking practice activities
- [Live Groups and Role-Play](https://sanako.com/live-groups-and-role-play): Collaborative speaking features for group discussions and role-play scenarios
- [Live and Asynchronous Teaching](https://sanako.com/teach-live-and-asynchronously): Flexible teaching modes supporting both real-time and self-paced instruction
- [Flashcards](https://sanako.com/flashcards): Vocabulary teaching tool for student practice and language acquisition
- [AP Exam Practice](https://sanako.com/ap-exam-practice): World Languages AP Exam preparation workflow and simulation tools
